Product Description

Revitalise your hair with the Alberto Balsam Tea Tree Conditioner 300ml. Infused with Pro-vitamin B5 and a mood-boosting fragrance, this conditioner nourishes, softens, and detangles hair, while leaving a refreshing 24-hour scent. With a silicone-free formula, it helps maintain healthy, smooth, and vibrant hair, giving you a boost of confidence every time you wash your locks.

Ingredients

Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Oil, Mentha Piperita Leaf Extract, Maltodextrin, Parfum, Panthenol, Pantolactone, Benzophenone-4, Lactic Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Chloride, Disodium EDTA, PEG-150 Distearate, Amyl Salicylate, Camphor, Menthol, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, CI 15985, CI 19140, CI 42090

Directions

  1. After shampooing, apply through the lengths of your hair, leave for 1–2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

Product Description

This belted all-in-one incontinence pad combines security with easy fixation. Ideal for heavy or continuous incontinence and ideal for normal toilet access where possible. The pad uses an integral belt to fix the product around the waist, with velcro fixation to locate the pad at the front. Curved double leg elastics and additional security barriers make for increased comfort and leakage protection.

Directions

  1. Apply the protector, change it as needed using the moisture indicator and dispose of hygienically.

Safety Warnings

Use with caution to avoid skin irritation. Do not use if you have a known allergy to any of the materials. Always ensure a proper fit to prevent leakage. Change the diaper immediately if the wetness indicator turns blue or if there is visible soiling. Dispose of used diapers hygienically according to local waste management guidelines. Always wash hands thoroughly after handling used diapers. For fecal protection, use with caution and consider using additional protection to prevent skin irritation and infection.
